summary: The sell-off has pushed to new lows: the Sensex is down about 1,000 points and PSU banks are adding to the pressure, leaving the Nifty near its worst levels with gains only in isolated stocks.

detail.leaders: Isolated stocks only: Som Distilleries, RPG Life Sciences, Power Grid
detail.laggards: PSU banks (Nifty PSU Bank −2%); private financials; auto, FMCG, metal; mid- and smallcaps
detail.tone: Worse than 10:30: the Sensex decline has widened from about 860 to about 1,000 points, so the Nifty is likely below its 10 am level of 22,882. PSU banks have joined the selling, and there is still no dip-buying.
